title: First steps · two choices, one counterexample
description: Standalone logic tutorial: every chosen(v) is true or false. Does that force at most one chosen value?
hint: One predicate, one axiom. Run the search, then inspect the two chosen values.

title: Voting · keep every assumption
description: Check agreement and unanimous delivery across small participant sets and quorum families.
hint: All three claims hold within the suggested bounds. Next, remove one assumption.

title: Voting · remove correctness
description: Can voting still guarantee agreement when the Correct axiom is removed? Search supplies the frame and valuation.
hint: Correct starts unchecked. Keep it again to compare the outcome.

title: Simpler Paxos · agreement
description: Investigate agreement with all twelve axioms, using the theory’s stutter convention for time.
hint: The search covers up to two participants, two values, and three stages.

title: Simpler Paxos · remove write uniqueness
description: Remove SPaxWrite01 and look for disagreeing decisions. Every retained axiom must still be satisfied.
hint: Open the counterexample and look for the two decided values.

title: Three truth values · small surprises
description: Inspect the difference between true, broken, and false in a one-participant model. Some conjectures deliberately fail.

title: Quorums · local and global
description: See why all points in the current quorum is different from all points in every quorum.

title: Recurrences · fixed points
description: Explore monotone recurrences and a nonpositive recurrence in a small declared frame.

title: Declarative Paxos
description: Check the declared finite scope of the full Paxos theory. Larger edits may need more time.

title: Bracha reliable broadcast
description: Inspect the assumptions and guarantees of reliable broadcast in the bundled scope.

title: Crusader agreement
description: Explore agreement with a distinguished half output in a small declared frame.
